With changing lifestyles, the number of people suffering from diabetes has increased in recent years， and diabetes has become a major global health problem. According to the 10th edition of the International Diabetes Federation（IDF）Diabetes Map 2021, 537 million adults aged 20-79 have diabetes, with a prevalence rate of 10.5%. Chinese medicine has good efficacy in the treatment of diabetes, and jujube is often found in Chinese herbal formulas because of its ability to benefit the Qi, nourish the blood, and moderate the medicinal properties. Usually, jujube is considered too sweet to be harmful to diabetic patients. However, some studies have found that jujube can lower blood sugar, improve glucose metabolism and regulate insulin-sensitive enzymes. There are currently no studies evaluating the efficacy and safety of jujube or prescription containing jujube in diabetes.
